content.bridge_context: Introduction to the concept of self-governance at the local level, where people decide for themselves.

units.title: What is Democracy?
units.explanation: A system where people have the power to choose their leaders and participate in decision-making.
units.dual_language_instruction: In your class, how do you choose a monitor? / आपकी कक्षा में मॉनिटर का चुनाव कैसे होता है?

units.title: Grassroots Level
units.explanation: The most basic level of society, like a village or a small neighborhood.
units.dual_language_instruction: Why is it easier to solve problems at the local level? / स्थानीय स्तर पर समस्याओं को सुलझाना आसान क्यों है?
